refs.purpose: Join the summary, ledger, snapshot, final workflow and their diff deterministically, so the report renders joins and findings instead of re-deriving them.
refs.verification: Promote after a nextflow-to-galaxy run's report lists every finding the command emitted and no difference the command marked recorded as unrecorded.

refs.purpose: Runs `gxwf diff --json` on the snapshot and the final workflow; `diff` needs a release newer than the pinned one.
refs.verification: Promote once the pinned `@galaxy-tool-util/cli` release ships `gxwf diff`.

refs.purpose: Read a snapshot step's `_plan_state`, `_plan_context` and TODO sentinels when explaining what the step was designed to carry.
refs.trigger: When a step's planned behaviour must be compared with its final state and the parity JSON does not settle it.

refs.purpose: Read each record kind the report links to: step drops, flag records under Source arguments, scope records under Source scope, plain gaps and decisions.
refs.verification: Promote after a worked run's report links each listed difference to the ledger entry that records it.

refs.purpose: Read source-side detail the command doesn't join: params, publishDir targets, closures in `resolved_args`, and `script_excerpt` flags.
refs.trigger: When a report row needs a source fact beyond what `foundry nextflow-parity` printed.

produces.description: Reviewable Markdown report of how the final workflow differs from the Nextflow source: outputs, tool versions, parameters and inputs, behaviour, scope, unverified items, and every difference with no recorded reason.

consumes.description: Structured Nextflow pipeline summary from [[summarize-nextflow]]: the source side of every comparison, including `effective_args` and each process's tool, container and conda.
Carried obligations ledger [[open-requirements-ledger]] as the run left it: the drops, flag records, scope records and gaps that give a difference its reason.
The draft as the per-step loop first received it, `_plan_*` intact, from [[advance-galaxy-draft-step]]: the designed workflow, and through `_plan_state.calls` the map from steps to source calls.
The final gxformat2 workflow after the test phase: the workflow the report compares with the source.
Structured handoff from [[run-workflow-test]]: its status says what the run verified, and a missing or red result leaves every claim in the report unverified at runtime.
